scope: Known official 414 and eight drift batches 12221 only. Decide whether replacing the approval rule on the actual observer output justifies changing the recommended entry. The verified seed-17 native-release-path is development evidence. Freeze before any new gate scores or retraining under the other draws.
shared: 13 original feedback seeds, all other training randomness fixed at [17,round]. Same original official checkpoint, half source / half all previously returned fitting samples, original class-balanced draws, epochs, Adam, class axes and disjoint halves as gas-native-feedback. One continuously advancing training path per seed (9/7 epochs), each native proposal precomputed once for all policies. No current service labels used. Observers get exactly the same 32 past labels; labels used for selecting a candidate are always disjoint from its fitting rows. Original public recommendation, fixed observer on root, fixed observer on most recent trained version, and fixed always-raw most recent model compete. Also compare the stronger independent mixed logistic on exactly the same feedback draws from the prior feedback-refit study, report that its label allocation and family differ. Reproduce seed-17 trajectories, not just aggregate scores.
decision: All candidates share the initial original weight and same ObserverErrors. Only replace how the current and candidate native votes are compared. Control uses strictly more correct native predictions on latest 16 confirmation rows. Treatment compares the same two candidates on the final calibrated predictions of the full five-component observer, keeping the observer counts as they were before that holdout arrived. Holdout labels cannot help calibrate their own validation predictions. Alternatives: strict positive net correct or nondecreasing correct for ties (fixed a priori). Include a fixed empirical rule: publish a trained version every second opportunity; keep root until the first such publication. All arms update their own observer counts from predictions actually made before receipt of each round's 32 labels. Also measure prospective room for improvement from raw versus calibrated alternatives: report where held-out predictions are exactly equal even when native differs.
gate: Promote to ordinary entry only if pooled macro-F1 mean across the 13 draws improves by .01 over each of current recommendation and strongest fixed arm on BOTH streams and the lowest class recall mean does not decrease by more than .02 versus either. Report mean, individual draws, total actual fits shared, training rows and CPU, and paired service-versus-raw effect, decision opportunities and ties. Keep known-data, native-only and strongest mixed standalone comparisons explicit. This comparison does not introduce a timing or threshold tuned to outcomes.
